welcome.title: Welcome to GLTCH Runner
welcome.subtitle: AI image & video — GLTCH PRO, WAN, and FLUX
welcome.body1: GLTCH Runner lets you generate, edit, and animate images and video using GLTCH engines.
welcome.body2: This quick guide will walk you through the basics. You can revisit it anytime from the help menu.

twoWays.title: Two Ways to Use
twoWays.subtitle: Bring your own key or use credits
twoWays.optionA: Option A: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)
twoWays.optionADesc: Paste your xAI API key and generate for free — you pay xAI directly.
twoWays.optionANote: Get an API key at console.x.ai
twoWays.optionBDesc: Subscribe to any plan to unlock 10 free daily credits, the spin wheel, and daily missions. You can also buy credit packs anytime — they never expire.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Set up in under a minute
gettingStarted.byok1: BYOK: Tap the key icon in the top bar, paste your xAI API key, and you're ready — generations bill xAI directly.
gettingStarted.credits1: Credits: Create an account, verify your email, then either subscribe (unlocks daily free credits + spin + missions) or buy a credit pack.
gettingStarted.step2: Pick a mode — Generate, Edit, or Animate — choose an engine (GLTCH is the default; GLTCH PRO is highest quality), and type a prompt.

generating.title: Generating Images
generating.subtitle: Text-to-image in seconds
generating.step1: Select the GENERATE mode from the mode selector.
generating.example: "A cyberpunk city at night with neon lights"
generating.step3: Hit Generate and wait for your image to appear below.
generating.tip: Tip: Use the Enhance button to automatically improve your prompt.

editing.title: Editing & Animating
editing.subtitle: Transform existing images
editing.editDesc: Upload an image and describe the change, e.g.
editing.editTip: Works with JPG, PNG, WebP, and HEIC photos.
editing.videoDesc: Upload an image and describe the motion to bring it to life as a short video.

organizing.title: Your Library
organizing.subtitle: Manage your creations
organizing.download: Download any result by clicking the download icon.
organizing.folders: Organize results into folders. Create, rename, and pin folders from the Library page.
organizing.warning: Important: Results are stored in your browser. Clearing browser data will delete them. Use folders and downloads to keep your work safe.

engines.title: Engines & Quality
engines.subtitle: Pick the right model for the job
engines.gltchProDesc: Highest quality. Best for finished work — slower, slightly more expensive.
engines.gltchDesc: Balanced speed and quality. Great for everyday generation, edits, and animation.
engines.grokDesc: xAI's official Grok models. Costs are doubled vs GLTCH; use BYOK to skip credits entirely.
engines.tip: Tip: GLTCH is selected by default for Generate and Modify. You can switch engines from the Advanced panel.

subscriberCredits.title: Subscriber-only Free Credits
subscriberCredits.subtitle: How daily credits, spin & missions work
subscriberCredits.body1: Daily free credits, the spin wheel, and the daily missions are exclusive to active subscribers. Pick any plan to unlock them.
subscriberCredits.body2: Credit packs and existing balances are unaffected — they always work, with or without a subscription.
subscriberCredits.body3: BYOK users skip credits entirely and pay xAI directly.

store.title: CREDIT_STORE
store.description: Subscribe to unlock 10 free daily credits + spin + missions, or buy credit packs anytime. Images: 1-2 cr · Videos: 5 cr · HD upscale: 7 cr.
store.xrgeBankTitle: $XRGE Bank — Deposit · Buy Credits · Earn Loyalty Rewards
store.xrgeBankDesc: Deposit XRGE, buy credits from your balance, earn up to +50% bonus.
store.cancelNotice: Your subscription is scheduled for cancellation. You can still use your remaining {{count}} sub credits until {{date}}. Reactivate anytime before then to keep your plan.
store.cancelNoticeNoDates: Your subscription is scheduled for cancellation. You can still use your remaining sub credits until the end of your billing period. Reactivate anytime before then to keep your plan.
store.manageDesc: Manage billing, update payment method, or cancel your subscription via the Stripe portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current billing period.
store.paymentInfo: Payments: Stripe (card) or $XRGE on Base (pack cards). Pack credits never expire. Subscription credits reset each billing cycle (no rollover).

referral.title: REFERRAL_PROGRAM
referral.descriptionSimple: Share your link — when a friend makes their first purchase, you get 10 credits and they get 5 bonus. If they subscribe, you get a free month.
